title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Get clear answers on the loan application workflow, CIBIL requirements, interest rates, and loan processing timelines.

items.q: What is a Direct Selling Agent (DSA)?
items.a: A Direct Selling Agent (DSA) acts as an authorized referral partner representing multiple leading banks and NBFCs to assist borrowers in choosing and acquiring the best loan product.

items.q: Does checking loan eligibility on DSA Finance affect my CIBIL score?
items.a: No, our pre-qualification engine performs a soft evaluation against bank criteria without initiating hard credit bureau inquiries.

items.q: What documents are required to apply for a loan?
items.a: Basic KYC (Aadhaar, PAN), recent salary slips / ITR returns, last 6 months bank statements, and relevant property/vehicle quotation documents.

items.q: How long does it take for loan approval?
items.a: Pre-screened applications forwarded by our DSA advisors typically receive bank sanction within 24 to 72 business hours depending on loan category.
